thread:
maria: Hey team — PR 4827 just hit the docs preview and failed CI. Linkcheck + Vale + spellcheck. CI: https://ci.internal.redwood/4827 (preview id: preview-4827)

harry: can you paste the failing output?

maria: sure — main complaints:
```
linkcheck: broken link /guides/deploy#private-deploy -> 404
vale: styles/Passivity: 'Use active voice' in docs/guides/migration.md: line 112
spellcheck: 'enviroment' -> 'environment' in docs/faq.md
```

rachel: argh that anchor changed when we re-org'd guides. I can fix the anchor on the source page, but that will change a couple urls.

maria: thanks rachel. If you push the anchor fix, we should re-run linkcheck only (faster). docs-bot can do a targeted retry if you add `ci:linkcheck-rerun` to the PR body.

docs-bot: @maria noted — to re-run only linkcheck add `ci:linkcheck-rerun` or use `/ci retry --job linkcheck`. Full rerun also available.

harry: I can take the Vale passive-voice line. Quick patch to reword will be fine. I'll open a fixup commit `fix: docs migration active voice` and force-push to the branch.

maria: perfect. who wants spellcheck? I can do the single word change in faq.

tony: I'll review after fixes. FYI we should avoid changing anchors mid-release window; if this blocks the merge slot tomorrow we might need to stage a redirect in nginx. :thinking_face:

rachel: good call. I'll add an HTML anchor alias to keep old links working and then update the page. That prevents redirects later.

maria: plan then: rachel pushes anchor alias change + PR update note, harry pushes the Vale reword, I push the spellcheck fix. After those three commits are up, i'll add `ci:linkcheck-rerun` to trigger the quick job and tag @tony for review.

harry: ETA 20m.

rachel: pushing in 10.

maria: pushed spellcheck now — commit `docs: fix faq enviroment typo`

docs-bot: Build started for preview-4827 (linkcheck only) — https://ci.internal.redwood/4827/rerun/1 :gear:

maria: linkcheck run is green now :tada: Vale still flags one sentence after harry's patch, I updated the wording.

harry: reworded again, no more passive voice flagged in migration.md.

tony: reviewing now. quick nits: change `deprecated` -> `legacy` in one place, otherwise LGTM.

maria: done (small replace). All green on preview and spell/vale/linkcheck. Can someone approve so we can grab the 9am merge slot?

tony: approved. :white_check_mark:

harry: approving and merging in 2m after confirming CI artifacts.

maria: thanks all — lesson: if you're moving anchors, leave an alias entry or update downstream references in the same PR. Saves a few retries.

rachel: noted. I'll add a short checklist to our docs PR template: "anchor changes: add alias + update crosslinks"

maria: tagging this thread for follow-up in the docs retro. :spiral_notepad:
